**PRIOR AUTHORIZATION APPROVAL**

**Date:** [Current Date]  
**To:** Ordering Provider  
**Re:** Prior Authorization for Laparoscopic Adjustable Gastric Banding  
**Patient:** [Patient Name]  
**Order Date:** June 22, 2025

---

**DECISION: APPROVED**

Your prior authorization request for laparoscopic adjustable gastric banding (CPT 43770) has been approved.

**Criteria Met:**

**BMI Requirement:** Met. Most recent BMI on 06/06/2025 is 43.3 kg/m², exceeding the required minimum of 35 kg/m².

**Obesity-Related Comorbidities:** Met. Patient has documented Type 2 diabetes mellitus (onset 02/12/2023) and osteoarthritis of the knee (onset 09/07/2018), both obesity-related conditions.

**Prior Weight Management:** Met. Medical record documents completion of a 6-month physician-supervised weight management program including dietitian visits and phentermine trial. Program was unsuccessful with minimal weight loss (2 kg net, subsequently regained).

**Covered Procedure:** Met. Laparoscopic adjustable gastric banding is a covered bariatric procedure.

---

This authorization is valid for 30 days from this letter. Please contact us if you have questions.
